runtime_style.visual_system: A monochrome rooftop fashion sequence alternates rolled mattress folds, self-containing body chains, a sheer full-frame veil, one steep parapet downshot and wide architecture-led figures under flat sky.
runtime_style.mood_line: Inward and unperformed: closed eyes and softened joints let cloth, grain, altitude and the city carry the tension.
runtime_style.environment: An anonymous high rooftop with worn deck, waist-height parapet and coping, a low white mattress or bedding mass, sparse cables or pipe hardware, dense low-rise city below and hazed distant hills under a retained-tone overcast sky.
runtime_style.lighting: The whole overcast sky acts as one broad soft source with a faint top bias, very soft form transitions, little or no crisp cast shadow and no backlight glow.
materials: worn rooftop deck and scattered small hardware
speckled parapet coping and flat inner wall
light sheer net or tulle that can settle, lift or cross the lens
fluid matte garment cloth without transferable motif
distant city masonry softened by focus and atmosphere
runtime_style.contrast: Low-to-medium global contrast with slightly lifted blacks, retained mid-grey architecture, a bright but non-clipped sky, soft highlight shoulder and visible grain at every value.
runtime_style.expression_signature: Eyes are normally fully closed with smooth unsqueezed lids, resting brows and cheeks, relaxed closed or barely parted mouth; the one open-eye state carries low lids and gaze past the lens.
runtime_style.garment_behaviour: Sheer cloth can hold air, crumple with small-radius folds, lie as a translucent grey layer or fill the lens; opaque cloth falls softly and nothing acquires sunlit glow or wet cling.
optical_signature: Strict monochrome with uniform silver-halide-like grain across sky, skin, cloth, architecture and city.
Slightly lifted blacks and a soft highlight shoulder preserve detail in both dark cloth and overcast sky.
No visible flare, halation, vignette or bloom; mild corner softness is allowed.
Depth of field and roll are shot-specific: close and downshot city planes may blur optically, while wide frames retain more context; rolled frames coexist with a level formal coda.

clean_identity_hero.camera_consequence: Use a standing medium horizontal frame from around chest height with a modest roll, keeping the approved face readable against a softly separated city.
clean_identity_hero.pose_joint_chain: Wrap both arms asymmetrically around the head and upper neck, lift one shoulder more than the other, keep elbows bent and eyes softly closed without copying source facial geometry or marks.
clean_identity_hero.focus: Place critical focus on the approved closed eyelids and near facial plane while the city recedes softly; retain grain on skin and sky.
clean_identity_hero.foreground: Keep the foreground clean and connected to the body; no veil crosses the face in this identity direction.
provenance: frame-08.jpg: standing self-embrace medium, asymmetrical shoulders, wrapped arms, closed eyes, rolled city background

environmental_hero.camera_consequence: Use a level wide horizontal frame from roughly waist-to-chest height, retaining the complete person, parapet corner, city bands and a large overcast-sky field.
environmental_hero.pose_joint_chain: Stand frontally with weight calm across both feet, arms abducted gently downward, elbows soft, palms turned back and chin level; keep the eyes closed and face unperformed.
environmental_hero.focus: Hold the approved person and parapet together, with the city readable but progressively softened toward distant hills.
environmental_hero.foreground: Use only the authentic roof deck as the lower plane; no mattress, veil or near limb may block the full figure.
provenance: frame-09.jpg: level formal frontal full-length at the parapet corner with gently abducted arms and closed eyes

sculptural_three_quarter.camera_consequence: Look down from a high oblique angle in a deliberately rolled horizontal frame so mattress, parapet and city become diagonal planes without inventing a universal roll value.
sculptural_three_quarter.pose_joint_chain: Kneel or fold compactly on the mattress, bring hands over the crown, close elbows around the face, round the upper back and keep the pelvis grounded rather than lying prone.
sculptural_three_quarter.focus: Keep the complete folded joint chain and near mattress texture readable while the city falls progressively softer.
sculptural_three_quarter.foreground: The mattress edge may form the lower near plane; no detached cloth mass or architecture crosses the face.
provenance: frame-03.jpg: high-angle rolled kneeling fold, hands over head, enclosing elbows, mattress and diagonal city/parapet

interference_frame.camera_consequence: Move to an extreme close horizontal portrait and shoot through one translucent cloth plane that fills the complete frame.
interference_frame.pose_joint_chain: Keep the head gently turned with eyes fully closed and unsqueezed, jaw loose and shoulders still; the connected hand may gather the veil outside the central face.
interference_frame.focus: Allow no plane to become clinically sharp, but retain enough eyelid, nose and mouth structure to identify the approved subject through the cloth and grain.
interference_frame.foreground: One translucent veil is the sole full-frame interference; do not add glow, double exposure, flare, water, glass or a second cloth layer.
provenance: frame-04.jpg: extreme close closed-eye face under a full-frame translucent veil with grain and soft retained highlights

material_or_accessory_detail.camera_consequence: Use a standing profile torso crop with the city kept low and soft, leaving space above the raised connected arm for the airborne sheer material.
material_or_accessory_detail.pose_joint_chain: Turn the body to profile, close the visible eye, lift one arm overhead and let the hand hold or release one edge while the other shoulder stays lowered.
material_or_accessory_detail.focus: Keep the approved profile, connected hand and nearest veil edge readable while the airborne trailing cloth and city soften naturally.
material_or_accessory_detail.foreground: The sheer veil may cross open sky but must not cover the approved face in this direction; no architecture-contact requirement is added.
provenance: frame-05.jpg: standing profile torso, closed eye, one connected arm overhead and a single airborne sheer veil

wide_campaign_coda.camera_consequence: Use a wide horizontal view from above deck level, preserving worn roof surface, sparse cables or pipe hardware, city and hills as distinct depth bands.
wide_campaign_coda.pose_joint_chain: Rest supine on a diagonal with one arm extended outward and the other bent behind the head, legs long but relaxed and shoulders surrendered to the roof plane.
wide_campaign_coda.focus: Retain the whole person and immediate rooftop hardware, allowing the far city and hills to soften without erasing environmental proof.
wide_campaign_coda.foreground: Worn roof, a small authentic cable or pipe and one settled sheer cloth mass establish the near plane; do not invent extra equipment or a surveyed layout.
provenance: frame-07.jpg: wide supine rooftop composition with unequal arms, settled sheer cloth, cables/hardware, city and distant hills
